tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Dark theme: the ink ground, preferred for site heroes, covers and event material.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and menus on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and input borders (decorative only; not for text).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink, taken from the logo. Primary text on surface, surface-raised and magenta-soft (17.8:1); also the dark brand ground for hero blocks and the app icon.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface or surface-raised (6.5:1).

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Brand magenta, taken from the logo. Fills (primary button, the 4LAB plate, hero blocks) and text 24px and up. White on it passes 4.5:1. As small text use magenta-deep; on ink grounds use magenta-bright (it reaches only 4.2:1 there).

tokens.name: magenta-deep
tokens.usage: Magenta for small text and links on surface, surface-raised or magenta-soft (4.8:1+), where brand magenta falls just short.

tokens.name: magenta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind magenta or ink text (tags, callouts, highlighted rows).

tokens.name: magenta-bright
tokens.usage: Magenta for use on ink grounds only: accents, numbers and links on dark blocks (5.7:1 on ink).

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a magenta fill (the primary button label, the 4LAB letters; 4.5:1).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Always-dark ink ground in both themes: hero bands, stat blocks and sticker outlines that must stay dark. Text on it uses on-magenta (white) or magenta-bright.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and button padding; gutters between related items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a card or slide.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page and slide margins; gap between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero blocks and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CTA buttons, tags and keyword chips: always fully rounded.
